title: Which expression?
statement:
Which expression gives the probability of getting **at least one head** in 5 tosses of a fair coin?

[_]{a}

explanations: Negative, so it can't be a probability.
Correct: 1 minus the chance of five tails.
That equals 2.5, which can't be a probability.
That is the chance of five tails (or five heads), not at least one head.

hints: Use the complement of "at least one head".
